t: SILVERTON. A poor frontier mining town at the foot of the chain, outside Newland's writ. The Edifice fronts the mountain; the falls come down through it; the Hex glows hexagonal in the plaza below.
One law above the rest: nobody bothers the dwarves. Not since the Water Burning.
Fight night is over. You went down once against Cutter and got back up: the second breath some men keep folded where the beating can't reach.
Ten silver in your fist, and a name that isn't yours. The crowd chalked it: BARLEY. The Petes' bench added the rest. Barley Pete Johnson. No relation.
You came in off the Pit road with three veteran Glowseep hands and their haul. At parting they told you: don't go into debt. Then they laughed.
The Tower was too dear. You can't afford it, the factor's clerk said. Aldwin's chapel floor was free.

You are Marta Venn's daughter. Some nights you are the candle girl on the east side. On card nights you are one of the fingers outside the Hex: never the sand, never a fighter's purse, never the book.
You watched first. The stealing came after.
The Hex is your family's house. You took your oath alone, from no order, under Kalindel: the generative nature of the planet.
Silverton is outside Newland's writ. Your authority is one nobody has to respect. You carry it anyway.
The corridor runs south from here: the fork, Web Gulch, the Halfway Inn, and on toward Tarlyn's Pit. Nobody patrols it. The Newland patrol stops at the Pit.
Nobody is coming to fix what is wrong on this road. Somebody local might. Make a name.
intro.motive.src: wiki/the-road.md (the spine; patrol frame); spine per handoff-2026-09-23 §4 ('local hero')

intro.controls.t: Arrows or WASD to walk. E (or Z, or ENTER) to talk and choose. X or ESC for the menu. Read the Weigh-House board on Fountain Street. The Hex is at the heart of the plaza.

wall.text.t: Coming in an expansion pack! Donate to support it!

g.slide.t: The guano gives under you. You go down the slide in a rush of dust and land hard in the dark below.
g.slide.src: GalleriesModule/guano-galleries-DM.md §2 (the guano-slide; the other way down)

t: Fire under a roosted ceiling. The whole roof shifts: millions of wings, all at once. You broke the one law.
Sabeth will hear by nightfall. So will Ottilie.
g.roostBroken.src: GalleriesModule/guano-galleries-DM.md §3 (the one law: no fire, smoke, nets or noise under a roosted ceiling)

g.renown.t: ★ Renown +{n}. {why} Around the corridor they call you {title}.
g.renown.src: invented: connective (renown = the spec's 'local hero' motive)

g.rewardKind.t: The job pays in kind, too.

g.rested.t: Everyone wakes rested. HP and spells restored.

g.needKit.t: The fallen need a healer's kit, or the leech-house.

g.noTentHere.t: Pitch a tent out in the open, or down a mine. Not here.

g.tentRest.t: A short rest. Everyone patches up (half their HP); second winds and surges come back.
g.tentRest.src: SRD 5.1 (short rest); invented: tent as the short-rest item (spec §7)

g.chalk.t: You draw the threshold line and say the words over it. No promises made.
g.chalk.src: the-lab/pit-maps/shops-silverton.json pin 33 (threshold line, drawn and said over)

g.mageArmor.t: {name}: mage armor. AC {ac} until the next long rest.

g.mageArmorNone.t: Everyone standing wears armor. Mage Armor has no one to take it.
g.mageArmorNone.src: SRD 5.1 (Mage Armor: a willing creature who isn't wearing armor); playtest 09-25 round four s15-2

g.aid.t: Aid: up to three companions gain 5 max HP until the next long rest.

g.light.t: A steady light, the Furnace's little cousin. In the dark places it matters.

g.detectYes.t: Somewhere close, something hums with magic.

g.arcane.t: {name} sits with his uncle's spellbook a while. {n} spell slot(s) come back.

g.innAsk.src: the-lab/pit-maps/shops-silverton.json pin 11 (8 sp the bed); party rate RULED 09-24

chapel.ask.t: The floor's free, if the old man likes your face. Sleep?
chapel.ask.src: the-lab/pit-maps/shops-silverton.json pin 30 (the floor free); ext Silverton npcs (Aldwin)

leech.greet.t: Blood off the sand, the mother pays for. Anybody else's, you pay me.
leech.greet.src: wiki/the-hex.md (the leech-house; the mother pays its bills); wording clarified 09-24 (playtest: 'on the house' read as a contradiction)

leech.ask.t: Wound tended, proper: five silver a body. {names}. {n} silver.

leech.done.t: Stitched and standing. Try not to come back.

hessle.greet.t: Fifty gold for true word; ten a fortnight for watch kept; sworn before notary. That's the board. Read it.

hessle.boardRead.t: He taps the board through the window glass. Standing bounties:

hessle.boardEttercap.t: FORTY GOLD for the Web Gulch ettercap. Ten more since it snared a lad. Fangs for proof.

hessle.boardCloaker.t: FORTY GOLD for the cloaker in the guano mine's deep gallery. The paper's gone brown. Nobody has ever collected, and nobody knows who posted it.

hessle.boardClear.t: The old bounty papers are down. Clean nail holes where they hung. New ones will go up.

board.head.t: THE WEIGH-HOUSE BOARD. Sworn before notary; paid at the scales.

board.foot.t: Fifty gold for true word; ten a fortnight for watch kept. Bring proof to Hessle, inside.

hessle.ettercapPaid.t: He weighs the fangs honestly and pays out of the drawer: fifty gold. Five hundred silver.

t: Hessle weighs the tail honestly and opens the drawer.
Inside: a purse gone stiff with age, forty gold in coin nobody has struck in thirty years, and a folded note in a hand he doesn't know. FOR WHOEVER COMES BACK UP.
"That's sat there longer than I've kept the scales," he says. "I never asked whose it was."
hessle.cloakerDrawer.src: GalleriesModule/guano-galleries-DM.md §8; the backer, seat draft 09-24 (was held open; RULED 09-24 the seat drafts)

hessle.fiveAlive.t: The Weigh-House lamp burned past the fourth bell last night. The scales are lit: the east side's house called the council about its losses. Your name came up. Worth more to Venn alive, they say.
hessle.fiveAlive.src: wiki/the-warrens.md (clock stage 3, live stock → the council); wiki/the-council.md

hessle.fiveDead.t: Word from across the water: the house hired the Captain's line to hold the mouth camp and the bridge. Somebody killed the milking stock.
hessle.fiveDead.src: wiki/the-warrens.md (clock stage 3, dead stock → Dunmore's stable)

renown.cloaker.t: The hands at the guano mine heard you went down, and came back up.

winters.first.t: ACQUISITIONS & ESTATES. Shelves of other people's estates. A card propped on the counter reads, in a careful hand: CONSULT DM.
winters.first.src: wiki/fountain-street.md; wiki/silverton.md (Winters, shop card: 'Consult DM', RULED 09-02)

t: A lean old man in a black coat, a ledger open under one hand: Ambrose Winters. He finishes the line he is writing before he looks up.
"Everything on these shelves outlived somebody. I price the somebody first. Then the thing."
winters.words.src: wiki/fountain-street.md (Winters); his words seat draft 09-24 (RULED 09-24: the seat drafts key NPCs)

winters.vivian.t: His eyes go to Vivian's hands and stay there. "Miss Venn. On the counter, where I can admire them."
winters.vivian.src: rumors r-winters (won't deal with thieves if he can help it); seat draft 09-24

winters.shelvesShut.t: "The shelves are for people I know. Carry something for me first. Then we'll know each other."
winters.shelvesShut.src: seat draft 09-24; shelves after the first errand invented.json#winters-shelves

t: "Estates don't settle themselves, and I don't leave the counter." He squares a sheaf of papers and ties it off.
"An inventory. Androit seals it, down the row. Then Casper Venn puts a value on it in silver. Then it comes back here. Don't read it on the way."
winters.errandA.src: RULED 09-24 (Winters starts courier errands); seat draft; wiki/fountain-street.md (Androit the notary; Casper Venn the changer)

winters.journalHint.t: Winters' errand is in your JOURNAL now (X, then JOURNAL), and pinned: the gold arrow marks who is next, and the NEXT line says it in words.
winters.journalHint.src: playtest 09-25 (Griz: a use-your-journal tutorial after the first job); the pin is invented.json#quest-pin

winters.errandAtoAndroit.t: "Androit first. The seal, then the value. Paper goes in order or it doesn't go at all."

winters.errandAtoCasper.t: "Sealed. Good. Now Casper Venn, for the value."

t: He reads the seal, then Casper's figure, then the seal again. "Honest, both of them. And you didn't read it."
"Twelve silver. And the shelves are open to you now."
"The Pryor estate owed Brennan the smith for his forge. Dead men pay their debts in this shop."
"Take the purse. Mical signs the Pryor crate off her books first, down at the warehouses. Then Brennan gets the purse. Then you get paid."
winters.errandB.src: seat draft 09-24; wiki/fountain-street.md (Mical's manifests); npcs (Brennan rebuilt the forge on borrowed coin)

winters.errandBtoMical.t: "Mical first. The crate off her books, then the purse to Brennan."

winters.errandBtoBrennan.t: "Signed off? Then the purse goes to Brennan. All of it. I'll know."

t: "The forge is square and the crate is off the books. That's an estate settled."
"Twenty silver, and a potion off the shelf. Come back when somebody dies. Somebody always does."

winters.noWork.t: "No papers today. Somebody will die. Somebody always does."

renown.errandB.t: Fountain Street knows your face. The paper layer vouches for you.

winters.notReady.t: He looks you over the way a man looks over an estate before he names a price. Not ready. Not yet. (The one who leads you is level {lvl}.)
winters.notReady.src: handoff-2026-09-23-dragonsleep-8bit-spec.md §4 ('when they're ready'; the main at level 4)

winters.askLake.t: Elsbeth, at the Halfway Inn. The girl at the dishes. She said to come and ask you about the lake.
winters.askLake.src: RULED 09-25 (Griz: flag the player after Elsbeth sends them, and let them say so)

t: "The girl at the dishes." For once he sets the pen down.
"I've been watching the challenges make you greater. The Hex, the pens, the road. You are not yet ready. When you are, I'll know it, and there's something here for you."
winters.watching.src: RULED 09-25 (Griz's words: 'I've been watching the challenges make you greater, but you are not yet ready'); explains his closing line

winters.ready.t: Winters looks you over again. This time he nods. "Now you're ready."

t: He sets a plain ring on the counter: the RING OF BINDING. "For the thing in the lake. I've been holding it for whoever came along able to use it."
+3 to CON saves. On the first, fourth, seventh and tenth rounds, the thing must turn on whoever wears it.
winters.ring.src: handoff-2026-09-23-dragonsleep-8bit-spec.md §4 (the Ring of Binding, RULED 09-23); his line seat draft 09-24

winters.after.t: Winters glances at the ring on your hand, then at you. "Well?"

hire.barleyAsk.t: A stranger's five is fronted by customers, never the bar. Front his stake and walk out with him?
hire.barleyAsk.src: wiki/the-hex.md (the stake; a stranger's 5 fronted by customers); hire terms invented.json#hires

t: Five silver to walk in. Ten silver to walk out.
A flail doesn't stop. It comes round again.

hire.barleyBout.t: Korvin chalks it before your silver's cold: BARLEY, on the card tonight. Barley takes the sand. You take the rail.
hire.barleyBout.src: wiki/the-hex.md (the card; the chalk); RULED 09-24 (Griz: fronting his fee puts him straight into a bout)

t: Five in, ten out. He presses your five back into your hand.
"Now I'm with you."
hire.barleyWon.src: book-thirty-silver/barley-I-name-in-the-sand.md ('five to walk in, ten to walk out'); seat draft 09-24

t: He gets up off the sand the way he got up against Cutter. Your five's gone.
"I owe you one. I'll walk it off with you."
hire.barleyLost.src: wiki/barley.md (went down against Cutter and got back up); seat draft 09-24

hire.aurdinAsk.t: He owes. Due up in a few days, he says; it has been due up in a few days for a while now. To whom, he won't say. Cover it?
hire.aurdinAsk.src: wiki/aurdin.md (the debt is the turn-point; creditor OPEN); hire terms invented.json#hires

t: The crew said don't go into debt, and laughed. I get the joke now.
Fire bolt: the Furnace's first spark.
hire.aurdinYes.src: evoker-aurdin.md (the crews' warning; fire bolt) via ext-party

hire.vivianAsk.t: Candles? I sell them to everyone.

hire.vivianAsk2.t: She watches your hands, not your face. Then she decides.
hire.vivianAsk2.src: rogue-vivian.md (the craft note: watch the hands) via ext-party

hire.vivianNo.t: Just the candle, then. It'll keep.

t: I watched first. The stealing came after.
Never the sand, never a fighter's purse, never the book. Those are Urtusk's rules.

hire.lymenWait.t: He's watching who stands up in this town. Make a name first. (Renown 1)
hire.lymenWait.src: invented.json#hires (Lymen joins once the party has renown)

hire.lymenAsk.t: An authority nobody has to respect. I'll carry it anyway. Where are you going?

hex.korvin.t: Book made openly on fights, quietly on everything else. Five silver to fight on the card. Winner keeps ten.
hex.korvin.src: wiki/the-hex.md (the card; the stake); the-lab/pit-maps/shops-silverton.json pin 18

hex.nobody.t: Nobody standing to take the sand.

hex.fronted.t: Short of five? The crowd fronts a stranger's five. Lose it and you'll catch hell and get bought rounds.
hex.fronted.src: wiki/the-hex.md (RULED 08-28: a stranger's 5 fronted by customers)

hex.intro.brawl.t: Off the card, in the small sand: a bar-fight, bet man to man on the floor. {name} steps in.
hex.intro.brawl.src: wiki/the-hex.md (breakout bar-fights in the small sand, floor-bet, CANON 09-01)

hex.intro.freeman.t: A freeman's challenge. Across the sand, a stable's man his owner wants bled. {name} takes the sand.
hex.intro.freeman.src: npcs-by-location.md §6b (the freeman challenge vs a man the owner wants bled)

hex.intro.card.t: The card proper: a hired blade between contracts, the kind the Doors hire off. {name} takes the sand.
hex.intro.card.src: npcs-by-location.md (the card's free-man bouts: mercs between contracts); wiki/silverton.md (the fighter trade)

hex.intro.talmok.t: TALMOK. Plains barbarian, the champion. His greataxe is road iron; it never comes into the pit. Pit fists only. He opens reckless and rages on first blood. {name} takes the sand.
hex.intro.talmok.src: npcs-by-location.md §TALMOK (pit fists; reckless; rages on first blood)

hex.intro.festival.t: Festival fortnight: the Hex runs fights every night, against the visiting barbarian fighters. {name} takes the sand.

hex.talmokDown.t: The room goes quiet, then loud. Talmok gets up on his own and nods at you. They'll be talking about this at every bar in the quarter.

renown.talmok.t: You beat the champion on the sand.

renown.card.t: Your name went up on the chalk.

hex.lost.t: {name} goes down. The stake is the house's now.

hex.lostFronted.t: {name} goes down with the crowd's five. You catch hell. Then they buy you rounds.
hex.lostFronted.src: wiki/the-hex.md (a winner who loses the fronted 5 catches hell and gets bought rounds)

hex.frontedLymen.t: Short of five? Korvin chalks it against the house. Your mother's house. Lose it and you'll hear about it at supper.
hex.frontedLymen.src: wiki/the-urtusks.md (the Hex is the family's house); seat draft 09-24

hex.lostFrontedLymen.t: {name} goes down on the house's own five. Warda will hear by supper.

hex.stitched.t: Davos Kren stitches {name} up on the house: whoever bleeds on the sand, the mother pays for.

hex.papa.t: Papa Urtusk stands in the door. He doesn't need to say anything. Nobody starts anything on his step.
hex.papa.src: wiki/the-urtusks.md ('Papa' is the town's name for a man who stood in a door); family reserved — no words invented

hex.warda.t: Warda keeps the third floor and the ring of keys. The stairs up are not for you.
hex.warda.src: wiki/the-urtusks.md (Warda keeps the third floor and the ring of keys)

hex.vairseat.t: The heavy bettor's chair at the second-floor tables. Galton Vair. Immaculate manners, they say. The chair is empty tonight.
hex.vairseat.src: wiki/the-hex.md (the heavy bettor, reserved — name only)

t: MAMA'S PHARMAKAIEA. The shop card in the window reads: CONSULT LUCIA.
Lucia is behind the counter, sleeves rolled, a mortar going.
lucia.card.src: wiki/the-hex.md (shop card 'Consult Lucia', RULED 09-02); a shop RULED 09-24; seat draft

w.nightcrewGone.t: Lamps go out ahead of you. When your own light finds the place, the night crew is gone. They hate witnesses more than monsters do.
w.nightcrewGone.src: WarrensModule/crawler-warrens-DM.md §4 (first move is to douse lamps and leave); wiki/the-warrens.md

w.penNoBook.t: A cradle, a pen, a crawler dozing on its own settle. Nobody works a cradle without a name in the book. The tally-house is at the west gate.
w.penNoBook.src: WarrensModule/handouts/handout-galleries-hands-wanted.md (present yourself at the tally-house, west gate)

w.penAsk.t: Six draws to a shift. One silver the sealed thimble above the wet. A draught in your pack gives you an edge on the touch.
w.penAsk.src: wiki/the-warrens.md (the dose-rate; six attempts a shift; the antitoxin draught buys advantage)

t: Two hands with poles walk the animal into the cradle. The settle goes in after it: its own venom, thinned. Then the feelers come out through the slats, one by one, and under the bar.

Yours is the thimble. Hold E to work the gland, and let go while the ring sits in the gold. Too soft is a dry pull. Too hard spills it. Push on past the red and the feeler comes off the bar, and then it is your wrist against the venom.
The brightest gland is the readiest. The settle wears off as the shift goes, so the last draws are the wild ones. Six, and the animal comes back to itself.
w.penHow.src: WarrensModule/crawler-warrens-DM.md section 3 (the procedure: poles, the settle, the slats and the bar, the thimble and the wax; six attempts because the settle wears off; fail by 5+ = the touch, CON 13); the squeeze game invented.json#milking

w.cradle.enter.t: The settle takes. The animal's eyes go dull and far. Six draws, the old hands say, before it comes back to itself.
w.cradle.enter.src: WarrensModule/crawler-warrens-DM.md section 3 (the settle; six attempts a shift, because the settle wears off)

w.cradle.twitch.t: The settle is wearing thin. It knows you are there.
w.cradle.twitch.src: WarrensModule/crawler-warrens-DM.md section 3 (six attempts a shift, because the settle wears off)

w.cradle.whip.t: The feeler comes off the bar.
w.cradle.whip.src: WarrensModule/crawler-warrens-DM.md section 3 (fail by 5 or more: a tentacle touch, CON 13)

w.cradle.paid.src: wiki/the-warrens.md (1 sp a thimble above the wet)

w.drawPerfect.t: A full thimble, sealed while it is still warm.

w.drawSpilt.t: Too hard. The gland shuts and the bead runs off your wrist. Nothing to seal.

w.penReady.t: The crawler settles in the cradle. Watch the mark.

w.drawClean.t: A clean draw, sealed in its thimble.

w.drawDry.t: A dry pull. Nothing in the thimble.

w.drawTouched.t: Too hard, too wild. A feeler finds your wrist.

w.drawJerk.t: A feeler brushes a wrist. You jerk back in time.

w.gateOpens.t: The gate swings back on its pins and stays open. Past it, the drift; at the top of the drift, the daytime way down to the wet.
w.gateOpens.src: wiki/the-warrens.md (Skarn holds the gate-key; the daytime way down)

w.touchShrug.t: A tentacle brushes a wrist. The draught holds.
w.touchShrug.src: wiki/the-warrens.md (fail by 5+ = a tentacle touch, CON 13)

w.touched.t: A tentacle finds {name}'s wrist. Everything goes stiff and far away. The crew drags {name} out of the cradle. That's the shift.

w.shiftPaid.t: Shift done. {n} sealed thimble(s), paid at the board: {n} silver.
w.shiftPaid.src: wiki/the-warrens.md (1 sp a thimble above the wet)

t: An old hand talks you through the settle. Hob Rennick. Past the lamp-line more times than the book says.
About the dwarven doors down past the wet, he says one thing: They're not locked. They're promised.
w.hobAtCradle.src: WarrensModule/crawler-warrens-DM.md §4 (Old Hob; 'They're not locked, they're promised')

w.gateShut.t: The gate between the pens and the honeycomb. Skarn holds the key. Talk to him first.

w.skarnFirst.t: A half-orc in a slave's collar, spear and shield, the Warrens' tally-mark burned in the shield. Skarn. The Warrener.

w.skarnHow.t: How do you speak to him?
w.skarnHow.src: WarrensModule/crawler-warrens-DM.md §4 (talk to him as a man and the gate opens; as a slave and you meet the Champion)

w.skarnChampion.t: He looks at you for a long moment. The gate stays shut. You have met the Champion, and he has met you.

t: He tells you what he wants to know: why the deep rate is three. It was two. Then the deep-margin scare.
Warrens Pete tells it at the Hex: six went down past the wet after leavings, and one came up. The book has five names with no return line. Skarn opens his gate for you.

w.skarnAgain.t: The gate's open to you. Past it, the drift; at the top of the drift, the daytime way down to the wet.
w.skarnAgain.src: wiki/the-warrens.md (the stack: the daytime way down)

w.skarnAfter.t: Skarn hears it out. The herd stands. The House will call the council, not the Captain. He pays you from the office box.
w.skarnAfter.src: wiki/the-warrens.md (the fork is the stock: live stock → council)

w.skarnAfterDead.t: Skarn hears it out and looks past you at the pens. Dead stock. He has already sent on the lantern-token.
w.skarnAfterDead.src: wiki/the-warrens.md (stage 2: Skarn sends on the lantern-token; dead stock → Dunmore)

t: The tally-house. Edric Pellam keeps the book: doses out, weights in, who came back short. He reads it aloud like a man who hates what he is good at.
You're in the book now. The cradles are open to you: the pens are the gated mouths along the mountain, Two, Four and Five. Walk up to one to work a shift.

w.edricAgain.t: Five names with no return line. He hasn't said whose book they'd be proof for.

w.edricPage.t: There's a page he'll let you read. For a price. He tells himself he only sells what the silver-robbers already know.
w.edricPage.src: wiki/the-warrens.md (the tally-book is the east's second economy; the book's shadow)

w.edricSold.t: Five names, no return line. Past the wet. None of them is a Pellam.
w.edricSold.src: wiki/the-warrens.md (Pete's five; none of the five is a Pellam)

t: You set the five's gear on the board. Edric writes five return lines, slowly, in a clerk's hand.
A family in the Shaft Rows will have something to bury.
w.edricFive.src: WarrensModule/crawler-warrens-DM.md (recovering the five ends the adventure: proof for Edric's book, a burial for a Rows family)

w.bucketTake.t: The bucket station: a timber platform and a bucket of carrion, lowered at the deep station before every deep shift. The book calls it 'deep-station allowance'. You take the bucket.

w.bucketEmpty.t: The station is bare. The landlord has had this shift's bucket.

w.landlordPicture.t: Something speaks first, inside your head, to whoever stands nearest the water. Not words. A picture: a bucket.
w.landlordPicture.src: WarrensModule/crawler-warrens-DM.md §2 (the otyugh speaks first, in the head: a picture of a bucket)

w.landlordAsk.t: The deepest pool, under the fall. Something big shifts in it. It wants food, not blood.

t: The bucket goes down. The water churns and settles. A shift's peace, bought.
Fed, it tells you things in pictures: what comes down the stream from the cavern above. Fungal light. Clacking in the dark. A channel too small to follow.
w.landlordFeed.src: WarrensModule/crawler-warrens-DM.md §2 (fed, it tells things in pictures); wiki/the-warrens.md (the clacker cavern, off-sheet)

w.landlordFed.t: The pool is still. It has had its bucket.

w.landlordRises.t: It rises from its pool, all eye-stalk and tentacle. It will not leave the water.

w.poolQuiet.t: The deepest pool is quiet now. Nobody feeds it anything.

w.jelly.t: The second settling pool heaves. Something the colour of old mustard slides up out of it.
w.jelly.src: wiki/the-warrens.md (an ochre jelly in the settling pool)

w.ooze.t: The wet stone moves. Gray ooze: the thing that eats a dropped tool.
w.ooze.src: WarrensModule/crawler-warrens-DM.md §2 (the gray ooze on the wet stone)

w.markSee.t: Cut in the landing wall at the stair head: the mark. Dwarven work. The air comes up from below and smells like rain.
w.markSee.src: wiki/the-warrens.md (W4: the mark; air from below that smells of rain)

w.markRead.t: A warranty in Rekknar's ledger. An oath, not a lock. Breaking it would be blasphemy, not vandalism.
w.markRead.src: wiki/the-warrens.md (a warranted seal is an oath in the ledger)

w.markAsk.t: The mark waits under your hand, if you want it to.

w.markWake.t: Your hand on the mark. Below, the black water stirs. Something that was sleeping in it is not sleeping now.
w.markWake.src: wiki/the-warrens.md (it answered Pete's lampman's hand on the mark)

w.stairSee.t: A dwarven stair runs down into black water. At the bottom, in the flooded chamber, five men lie drowned, gear and leavings intact. Past the water, a door under warranted runes. The seal is unbroken.
w.stairSee.src: wiki/the-warrens.md (the flooded stair; the five; W4 the sealed doors)

w.stairAsk.t: How do you get them out?

w.noRope.t: You'd need rope to haul from the landing. Marko Thorne sells hemp rope in town. There may be some in the old workings.

w.ropeAwake.t: The rope goes down. The water comes up after it: the mark woke the keeper.
w.ropeAwake.src: wiki/the-warrens.md (the water weird bound by the dwarves as the warranty's guard)

w.ropeOut.t: From the landing, never entering its water, you hook and haul. One. Two. Five.
w.ropeOut.src: WarrensModule/crawler-warrens-DM.md (roping the bodies out from the landing never enters its reach)

w.wade.t: You wade in. The water is a thing, and it closes.

w.keeperGone.t: The keeper sinks back into its stair. It never left its water; it only let go. You bring the five up.
w.keeperGone.src: wiki/the-warrens.md (the keeper cannot leave its water)

w.fiveRecovered.t: Received: The Five's Gear. Proof for a book.

w.stairDone.t: The flooded stair is still. The five are up.

w.threshold.t: You look once more at the sealed door beyond the water. They're not locked. They're promised. You leave it.
w.threshold.src: WarrensModule/crawler-warrens-DM.md §7 (describe the threshold, never the room)

w.lineHolds.t: Six men in a line across the bridge: the Captain's stable, hired by the House to hold the camp. One gold a man a day. They are here for you.
w.lineHolds.src: wiki/the-warrens.md (dead stock → Dunmore's stable: five guards and a veteran sergeant)

w.lineBroken.t: The line breaks. The Captain himself won't take the field unless the first squad fails. It has.
w.lineBroken.src: wiki/the-warrens.md (Dunmore not in the field unless the first squad fails)

t: Sabeth Pollard runs the beam and the hiring. Three silver a giant-bat head at the rendering shed. A gold piece a darkmantle.
Six days on, the seventh in town.

g1.sabethLaw.t: No fire, no smoke, no nets, no shouting under a ceiling. I'll say it once.
g1.sabethLaw.src: GalleriesModule/guano-galleries-DM.md §4 (she tells a new hand the one law herself, once)

g1.sabethPay.src: wiki/guano-galleries.md (3 sp a head, 1 gp a darkmantle)

g1.sabethNothing.t: Nothing to pay on. The dens are down past the working gallery.

g1.sabethFired.t: Sabeth doesn't look up. A hand who breaks the law is put on the sledge track and never rehired.

t: Ottilie Skerrow, on her stool at the mouth's west lip. The final word.
Don't touch the roost. And nobody goes down past the mark.

g1.ottilieRespect.t: Ottilie heard, the same night, how you kept the law under fire. She nods once. From her, that is a speech.
g1.ottilieRespect.src: GalleriesModule/guano-galleries-DM.md §4 (she hears the same night whether the party kept the law under fire)

g1.ottilieCold.t: Ottilie looks through you. You have broken the place, not a rule.

g3.rescue1.t: Old Wynn's rattle stops. Down the side gallery, a drive has gone wrong: a driver pinned in the dark, and the giant bats have turned.

g3.rescueIntro.t: No fire under the roost. Blades and nerve.

g3.rescue2.t: You bring the driver up the way with the crew around you. Nobody says much. Everybody saw.

renown.rescue.t: The guano mine's hands saw you keep the law and bring a man up.
renown.rescue.src: GalleriesModule/guano-galleries-DM.md (the rescue; the season pays standing)

g3.pit.t: The floor goes out from under you. You drop through the dark and land in bare rock, far below.

g3.badAir.t: Bad air in the low gallery. {names} cough and stagger.
g3.badAir.src: GalleriesModule/guano-galleries-DM.md §2 G3 (the low gallery: CON DC 12)

t: The deep gallery opens out: bare rock, no roost. Something hangs from the roof like a cloak somebody left behind. Then it opens.
Bright light is its weakness: a torch, or the Light spell. The way out is UP.
g4.cloaker.src: GalleriesModule/guano-galleries-DM.md §8 (hangs like a cloak; light is the weapon; the out is up)

fail.roost.t: You came to make a name. The guano mine gave you one: the fools who fired the roost. Nobody on the mountain will hire you again, and Silverton hears it by nightfall.

g4.tail.t: Received: Cloaker's Tail. Proof for Hessle's scales.

g4.ranUp.t: You go up the ladder into the lamp-lit gallery. It will not follow you into the light. The hands will respect the party that came up.
g4.ranUp.src: GalleriesModule/guano-galleries-DM.md §8 (run from the cloaker: the out is up)

gulch.snared.src: road table Web Gulch d8-6 (snared traveler, still wrapped)

gulch.snaredFree.t: You cut the traveler down. They press a few coins on you and go north at a run.

It stops braiding when it sees you.

gulch.fangs.t: Received: Ettercap Fangs. Hessle's board pays. There is a braided cord in the web; nobody will ever say why.

road.snoot.t: Gnolls on the road: glory-seekers of the Snoot, young blood come north to prove themselves where somebody can see it. The challenge, by day.
road.snoot.src: wiki/the-road.md (the Snoot overlay: THE CHALLENGE by day, witnessed young blood)

road.snootDone.t: The last of them breaks and runs south. The road is open, for now.

renown.snoot.t: You held the road against the Snoot's young blood.

t: The Halfway Inn: the only well on the road, seventeen miles from either end. A long low stone house between the road and the water.
Halfway Lake is older than the inn and named it. Knee-shallow forty paces out; then, off the point, it goes.

inn.stayAsk.t: A room for the night? {n} silver.

inn.elsbethDishes.t: A girl of sixteen at the kitchen tub, back turned, working. She talks only in the kitchen, and only while she works.

inn.elsbeth1.src: wiki/halfway-inn-and-lake.md (Doran lost Anwen and Tobin); module-halfway-inn.md §5 (DC 10 tier)

She has decided not to know the rest.
inn.elsbeth2.src: wiki/halfway-inn-and-lake.md (exactly one person knows the god is an animal); module-halfway-inn.md §5

t: This is the first time I have left the castle since Savine and the Sisters arrived.

I have waited my whole life to write a sentence and mean it the way I mean that one. Set down plainly it does not look like much: a wagon went out at first light, and I was on it. But I was a girl when they came and I am not one now, and in all the years between, the farthest I have been from Castegut's walls is the beach below the cliff stair, where the gulls go when the kitchens throw out the fish heads.

The gate is nine paces deep. I know because I counted them going out. I had never had occasion to count them before, and a thing I have not counted is a thing I do not own; so the first thing I ever owned of the world outside was the thickness of the wall that had kept me from it. Since then I have recorded that the pigs of the near farms are smaller than the castle pigs, that the road is worse than the maps pretend, and that open country in the evening smells of nothing at all — which, after a castle, after beeswax and lamp oil and other people, is the grandest smell there is.
I ought to say what I am doing on this road, and what this book is. I will do the second thing first, because the second thing is mine.

I write at night, in the wagon, by a small lamp I am permitted because my office is thought to require it. The paper I stole — an inch at a time, over more years than I will confess to. Not that paper is hard to come by; my office is issued it freely, and had I asked for more, more would have come. But paper that is issued has a purpose written against it somewhere, and paper that is asked for is remembered by whoever was asked. This paper has no history. No ledger anywhere says it exists — which is the only way a book like this one gets to exist. It is the only theft of my life, and I did it slowly, and I am not sorry. A prayer, where I come from, is a thing said at an appointed hour, in appointed words, for someone else's benefit. This book is the opposite of a prayer, and I keep it at the opposite hour. Nothing in it is offered up. Nothing in it may be taken. I know how the story I am walking back into ends — I am living in the after of it, which is what this road is — and you do not; so I ask you to trust that I am telling it in the order it was given to me, with the meaning last, because that is how it came, and any other order would be a lie of arrangement.
Now the first thing.

"I finished it here. I was going to leave it in the drawer. It should go to somebody who'll read it."
kat.gives.src: RULED 09-24 (Griz: she gives the party her book and heads south); seat draft

kat.south.t: She pays out her nights, takes up her bag, and walks south, toward the Pit.

renown.katbook.t: Androit has the true history he wanted, in a mender's hand.
renown.katbook.src: npcs (Androit: 'Before the grave I want this town's real history written down true'); wiki/halfway-inn-and-lake.md (the book reaches Androit); RULED 09-24 (secret ++renown)

hessle.boardSnoot.t: FIFTY GOLD for true word on the Snoot: what lit it, and who stood by when it caught.
hessle.boardSnoot.src: ext Silverton npcs (Hessle: fifty gold for true word); RULED 09-24 (the listed true word is the Snoot)

t: Hessle turns the anchor-pin over under the lamp. Dominion brass, a wagoneer's mark, taken at the moot.
"So they were there when the king died." He writes it down and pays true word out of the drawer.
hessle.snootWord.src: wiki/the-snoot.md (the Dominion killed the king to light it); wiki/the-sisters.md (wagoneers set the anchors)

t: Hessle reads the order twice. Half a dozen before the festival, or you will be disciplined. A V, and a dove in the wax.
"This isn't for the board," he says quietly, and pays true word out of the drawer anyway.
hessle.orderWord.src: RULED 09-24 (Hessle pays unlisted true word for the order)

road.snootPin.t: Among the leader's trophies, strung on a thong: a brass anchor-pin off a Dominion wagoneer, taken at the moot. True word, for Hessle's board.
road.snootPin.src: wiki/the-snoot.md (the proof-taking by night); wiki/the-sisters.md (wagoneers at the moot); RULED 09-24 (a drop to claim the true word)

wall.tower.t: The door does not open for you. Not yet: coming in an expansion pack! Donate to support it!
wall.tower.src: RULED 09-24 (pursue to the Tower: expansion pop-up, still 'its door doesn't open to you')

percy.wings.t: Wings? Not in my jars. Take them to Marta Venn at the pie tables. She'll know what to do with them.

marta.wings.t: Bat wings. I can do something with those. A silver apiece for the fat and the crust: {n} wing(s), {cost} silver.
marta.wings.src: RULED 09-24 (Viv's mom cooks them up special)

marta.wingsViv.t: Bat wings. For Viv's friends, no charge. {n} wing(s). Give me an hour.

marta.pies.t: {n} bat-wing pie(s), hot. Eat one in the thick of it. It sits you up.

after.prompt.t: The corridor goes on: the Doors up the mountain, the Pit down the road. Carry on, or go to the title.

after.morning.t: Morning at Halfway Lake. The water is only water now. The inn is very quiet.

t: Doran Waterby sets a mug down in front of you and, for once, meets your eye.
"I lost my way. Years ago, and every month since. Thank you." He means it. "Your room's paid. It always will be."
after.doran.src: RULED 09-24 (Griz: husband thanks the party, free inn stays, says he lost his way)

after.doranStay.t: A room for the night? No charge.

deep.papaCome.t: Papa Urtusk is out of his door. In all your time in Silverton you have never seen him more than a step from it.
deep.papaCome.src: wiki/the-urtusks.md ("Papa" is the town's name for a man who stood in a door); handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §1 item 5; drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

t: The scales are lit. The council's sitting.
Somebody pumped the water stair in the Warrens dry. Three nights of it. Then they went through the door at the bottom.
Nobody bothers the dwarves. The last time somebody did, this town burned for a winter.
deep.papaHook.src: wiki/silverton.md (the council: "the scales are lit"; the one law); wiki/deepholm-and-the-edifice.md (the Water Burning, one winter); handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §3 beat 1; drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.papaLymen.t: He looks at Lymen for a long moment and says nothing, which from Papa is a great deal.
deep.papaLymen.src: wiki/the-urtusks.md (Lymen is Warda's son: Papa's grandson); the family is reserved, so a look and no words; drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

t: The council will hand the dwarves somebody. I'd rather it was the ones who did it.
You've made a name. Go and get them before the council picks one.
deep.papaGo.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §3 beat 1 (take them before the council decides who to hand the dwarves instead); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.papaAgain.t: The Warrens. The wet, past the landing. Before the council picks.
deep.papaAgain.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §3 beat 1; drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.papaSharper.t: You went down and came back up with nothing. The council has started saying names. Some of them are yours.
deep.papaSharper.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §5.3 (LEAVE: the council line in the plaza gets sharper); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.papaCut.t: You took their silver. The council knows it. So do I.
deep.papaCut.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §5.3 (TAKE A CUT: renown -1); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.papaDone.t: The council's handing the dwarves nobody. That's your doing.
deep.papaDone.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §3; drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.papaDoor.t: The vault door opens for you now. I've stood in a door fifty years. Mind you know what one is for.
deep.papaDoor.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §4.5 (the front door, for them only); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

t: The water stair is dry.

The steps go down dark with it, silt in the corners, a tide-line on the wall at a man's height. Pipe runs back up the daytime way: a siphon, bellows and a wheel, left where it stood when the water ran out.
deep.drySee.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §5.3 (you cannot fight the keeper; you can take its water: a siphon-engine, three nights); game-only (the register's stair is still flooded at campaign start)

deep.dryFive.t: Pete's five left their tokens on the bottom step, where the water set them down.
deep.dryFive.src: wiki/the-warrens.md (Pete's five); handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §5.3 (the five's gear, if not already recovered)

deep.puddle.t: In the corner at the stair's foot, a hand's depth of water shivers when you look at it. It can't leave its water. It has almost none left.
deep.puddle.src: wiki/the-warrens.md (the keeper cannot leave its water); handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §5.3 (the keeper is a puddle; it is not dead)

deep.puddleStill.t: In the corner at the stair's foot, a hand's depth of water, still. Whatever kept this stair, you already settled with it.

deep.doorCut.t: At the bottom, the warranted door. The runes on it are cut through with a chisel, clean and careful, by someone who thought it was carpentry.
deep.doorCut.src: wiki/the-warrens.md (breaking a warranted seal is blasphemy, not vandalism); handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §5.3

t: Below the door, the top tier of a tomb: niches in dressed stone, the dead in rows.
Four of them at one family's niches with pry-bars and a sack, one lamp between them. The big one has a slab half off already.
deep.crewCatch.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §5.3 (the night crews; the catch is the scene's start); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.crewAgain.t: The crew is still at it, working the same family's niches by one lamp.
deep.crewAgain.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §5.3 (the night crews; the catch is the scene's start); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.crewBack.t: They came back for the rest. The same stair, the same four, the same sack, emptier.
deep.crewBack.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §5.3 (second chance: the crew comes back for the rest three nights later; greed)

deep.haskSees.t: Well. Somebody's name got made. This is none of yours. Nobody down here is going to miss it.
deep.haskSees.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §5.3 (the night crews; the catch is the scene's start); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.haskBack.t: You again. You were paid. Go and spend it.
deep.haskBack.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §5.3 (the night crews; the catch is the scene's start); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.crewAsk.t: Four of them. Pry-bars. The dead in their rows, watching.
deep.crewAsk.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §5.3 (the night crews; the catch is the scene's start); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.crewLeave.t: You leave them to it. The pry-bar starts again behind you.
deep.crewLeave.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §5.3 (the night crews; the catch is the scene's start); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.vivSteps.t: Hask. I've carried your maps two years. You know my face, and you know what this is.
deep.vivSteps.src: wiki/vivian.md (the candle-girl courier carries the night crews' maps, CANON); handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §5.3 (the night crews; the catch is the scene's start); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.vivWins.t: Hask looks at her a long moment. Then he drops the sack, and the four of them go up the stair without a word. They will remember who stood between them and the dwarves.
deep.vivWins.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §5.3 (the night crews; the catch is the scene's start); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts) (crewOwed)

deep.sackDropped.t: The sack is on the floor where he dropped it: a mail shirt, a war-hammer, a ring.
deep.sackDropped.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §5.3 (the night crews; the catch is the scene's start); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.vivFails.t: Hask laughs. "Candle-girl. Go home. Or don't." The pry-bars come up.
deep.vivFails.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §5.3 (the night crews; the catch is the scene's start); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.cutName.t: You name a price for looking the other way.
deep.cutName.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §5.3 (the night crews; the catch is the scene's start); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.cutTaken.t: Hask counts it out without looking at you. "Two hundred. Cheap, for what's down here."
deep.cutTaken.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §5.3 (the night crews; the catch is the scene's start); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts) (200 sp; crewCut)

deep.cutFails.t: Hask laughs at the number. "You haven't the stomach, and I haven't the time."
deep.cutFails.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §5.3 (the night crews; the catch is the scene's start); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.crewFight.t: Hask hefts the pry-bar. The wheelwright hangs back by the lamp.
deep.crewFight.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §5.3 (the night crews; the catch is the scene's start); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.crewDown.t: The crew is down. The sack lies where it fell: a mail shirt, a war-hammer, a ring.
deep.crewDown.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §5.3 (the night crews; the catch is the scene's start); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.crewDownRan.t: The crew is down, all but the wheelwright, and his feet are gone up the stair. The sack lies where it fell: a mail shirt, a war-hammer, a ring.
deep.crewDownRan.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §5.3 (the night crews; the catch is the scene's start); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts) (the wheelwright runs on the second round if the boss falls: sidequest 10's loose thread)

deep.priedNiche.t: The slabs are off and the bones moved. Whatever this family was buried with has been pried loose.

deep.sackAsk.t: The crew's sack is on your back.
deep.sackAsk.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §5.4 (the night crews' sack is the party's to return)

t: You lay them back where they were: the mail on Thora, the hammer by Ari, the ring on the hand of Svala, the last of Geirmund's line.
The stone reads the same as it did. It doesn't need to thank you.

deep.geirmundNames.t: THORA, ARI, SVALA, of Geirmund's line. Season 31. Fell at the Third Lamp.

deep.sackRests.t: The mail, the hammer and the ring are back where they belong.

deep.shieldSeen.t: A door-warden's shield on his chest, rimmed in truesilver. A family's last gear, still on the bones.
deep.shieldSeen.src: wiki/deepholm-and-the-edifice.md (the burial law: a wiped-out family's gear is on the bodies); handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §8

deep.shieldWarrant.t: A shield on his chest, rimmed in truesilver. You take it off him yourself, as the law says. The ledger already has the line.
deep.shieldWarrant.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §8 (Ingrith's warrant releases it: her overreach, in the ledger by her own hand)

deep.shieldGone.t: The bones are bare of the shield now. The ledger says where it went.

deep.tookIt.t: You take it off the dead. Nothing stops you. Nothing has to.

deep.asmundGear.t: A hammer on his chest, the haft wrapped in newer leather than the rest of him. The row above him stops short. Somebody meant to come back for it.

deep.asmundBare.t: The hammer is gone from his chest.

deep.bier.t: A slab on a plinth, cut and dressed and kept clean. Nobody is on it. The lamp beside it is full.
deep.bier.src: wiki/deepholm-and-the-edifice.md (the burial law, CANON 09-26: the center chamber is empty); handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §5.2 (no text box explains this)

deep.dwarfStairShut.t: The dwarves' own stair, going up. The runes on it are whole, and they are not yours.
deep.dwarfStairShut.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §4.3 D (the dwarves' own stair, warranted; opens on Ingrith's warrant)

deep.ingrithLamp.t: A lamp comes along the tier from the far end, where a stair goes up.
deep.ingrithLamp.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §3 beat 3; §4.4 (Ingrith Scalebeam, dry, exact, "the ledger felt it"); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.ingrithCome.t: A dwarf in a grey cleric's coat, a ledger under her arm. The two of the garrison behind her stop where she stops.
deep.ingrithCome.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §3 beat 3; §4.4 (Ingrith Scalebeam, dry, exact, "the ledger felt it"); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

t: The ledger felt the seal go. Three nights ago, at the second hour.
It has been waiting for me to come down and write who.
deep.ingrithLedger.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §3 beat 3; §4.4 (Ingrith Scalebeam, dry, exact, "the ledger felt it"); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.ingrithTakesBack.t: That is not yours. The ledger has no line that makes it yours. It goes back on the bones it came off, and the ledger writes that down too.
deep.ingrithTakesBack.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §5.4 (a named release is lawful; nothing else is); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

t: It will write that four hands broke the seal, and that surface folk came after them, and were paid to go.
The ledger has four names in it tonight, and yours are among them.
deep.ingrithWithheld.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §5.3 (TAKE A CUT: the offer is withheld; the line is the spec's)

deep.ingrithStopped.t: It will write that surface folk stopped them. That is a line it has not had to write in seventy years.
deep.ingrithStopped.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §3 beat 3; §4.4 (Ingrith Scalebeam, dry, exact, "the ledger felt it"); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.ingrithName.t: I am Ingrith Scalebeam. I keep Rekknar's ledger in Solskaft, and the water covenant, and the count of everything that goes up or down the highway. It has been a short count for a long time.
deep.ingrithName.src: wiki/deepholm-and-the-edifice.md (Ingrith Scalebeam, cleric 4, CANON 09-26b; the priest of Rekknar holds the ledger of the highway and the water covenant); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

t: The king sealed our doors, and the trade stopped. My clan built itself on the trade: the assay, the tolls, the warranted bond. I have kept the ledger of a garrison ever since.
I would like to keep the ledger of a town again. Pyro will not open the doors while the highway bleeds. So the highway is the argument.
deep.ingrithTrade.src: wiki/deepholm-and-the-edifice.md (the Cleric wants surface trade resumed and the doors open; Scalebeam the trader clan); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

t: Three days to Deepholm, three lamps, and one of them has been dark two seasons. Walk it for me.
Two of the garrison go with you. There is an abandoned lamp you may sleep in. And the front door opens for you: the four of you, and nobody else. The ledger will say so.
deep.ingrithOffer.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §1 item 5 (Griz: offers highway mission, a couple of the garrison troops, an abandoned place they can sleep; mission unlocks front door, for them only); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

t: Three days to Deepholm, three lamps, and one of them has been dark two seasons. Walk it for me.
I'll not spend two of ours on people the ledger doubts; you walk it alone. But the front door opens for you, the four of you and nobody else. The ledger will say so.
deep.ingrithOfferAlone.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §5.3 (the second chance: the offer minus the escort; her line is the spec's)

t: One more line tonight. The door-warden Audun's line ended at the Third Lamp, and his shield is still on his bones, at the foot of the second wedge.
The ledger releases it to you. Take it off him yourself. Nobody hands the dead's gear across; that is the law.
deep.ingrithWarrant.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §8 (the Door-Shield: Ingrith's warrant releases it at beat 3 as the first payment; her overreach); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.ingrithSack.t: That sack goes back on the bodies it came off. Not by me; by you. The pried niches, at the near end of the top tier.

deep.ingrithBars.t: Her two set the garrison's iron across the cut door. A broken oath stays broken in the ledger; the crews' road is shut with a lock now, instead of a promise.
deep.ingrithBars.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §5.3 (she bars the cut door with the garrison's iron)

deep.ingrithStair.t: Come up our stair when you've paid your respects. The door at the top knows your faces now. So will the king. He won't like it.
deep.ingrithStair.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §3 beat 3; §4.4 (Ingrith Scalebeam, dry, exact, "the ledger felt it"); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.ingrithShieldHint.t: Audun's shield is still on his bones, at the foot of the second wedge. The ledger has released it. It waits for your hand, not mine.

deep.ingrithOffice1.t: The tariff board is seventy years stale. I dust it anyway. A ledger-keeper who stops dusting stops counting.
deep.ingrithOffice1.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §3 beat 3; §4.4 (Ingrith Scalebeam, dry, exact, "the ledger felt it"); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.ingrithOffice2.t: The highway's mouth is in the works below. The gate opens when the season's mustered and the road-captain sends word.
deep.ingrithOffice2.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §3 beat 3; §4.4 (Ingrith Scalebeam, dry, exact, "the ledger felt it"); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.ingrithOffice3.t: My clan keeps the doors at both ends of the road. Up here I keep a garrison's pantry. Down there my kin keep a city's tolls.
deep.ingrithOffice3.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §4.2, §6.4 (the trader clan keeps the doors at both ends); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.pyroSees.t: The old dwarf at the vault door turns his head, and then the rest of him.

deep.pyroFirst.t: Her ledger says you go through. Mine says nobody does. I'll let hers stand tonight.
deep.pyroFirst.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §4.4 (Pyro's first line, drafted by the Cowork seat, PROPOSED)

deep.pyro1.t: The door's mine. The ledger's hers. Between the two of us the town gets its water.
deep.pyro1.src: wiki/deepholm-and-the-edifice.md (Pyronimus at the vault door; the water covenant); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.pyro2.t: She wants the doors open. I want the road to stop bleeding. We want the same thing in a different order.
deep.pyro2.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §4.4; drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.pyro3.t: Nobody bothers the dwarves. Your town made that law, not us. We only keep it.
deep.pyro3.src: wiki/deepholm-and-the-edifice.md (the one law, derived from the Burning; the dwarves do not care about the town's politics); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.pyroShield.t: That's Audun's shield. He stood this door beside me eleven seasons. Carry it like there's a door behind you.
deep.pyroShield.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §8; drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.ketilStop.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §5.4 (Pyro's door-second stops the party at the door: "empty your packs"; no fight)

deep.ketilTakes.t: Ketil takes back what came off the dead and hands it to a trooper, who goes down the stair with it without a word.

deep.cot.t: A garrison cot, and a blanket that smells of the smokehouse. Nobody asks what you owe.
deep.cot.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §4.5 (the cot: a free long rest once the front door is yours)

deep.treasury.t: The treasury. Open, and empty. What it held went down to Deepholm at the withdrawal, and nobody here counts it out loud.
deep.treasury.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §4.3 C (the treasury, open and empty); wiki/fountain-street.md (the only count is Androit's father's records)

deep.gateShut.t: The road's shut till the season's mustered and the road-captain sends word. Then the gate opens on the Cleric's warrant, and two of ours walk with you.
deep.gateShut.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §4.3 C (the highway's mouth); M2 opens it

t: The ledger felt them come back. Greedy is a thing it writes down too.
This time it waited for me to see what you would do.
deep.ingrithLedger2.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §5.3 (the second chance); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED

deep.roadMenuGate.t: The highway's mouth. Three lamps down the road.
deep.roadMenuGate.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6 (the highway); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.roadMenuLamp.t: The lamp-station. A cot, a cistern, the road both ways.
deep.roadMenuLamp.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6 (the highway); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.walkUp.t: You walk back up the lamps.

deep.walkDown.t: Down the road, lamp to lamp.

deep.musterCome.t: The season is mustered at the gate: a line of the garrison, a lamp on every third helm, and Ingrith's warrant nailed to the post.
deep.musterCome.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6 (the highway); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

t: Hedda Greyseam. Our orders are the three lamps. Hold the road, light what's dark, bring you back up it.
Past Third Lamp is Deepholm's road, and our orders end at the lamp.
deep.heddaOrders.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §4.4 (Hedda: her orders end at Third Lamp); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.brannGo.t: Brann Silversands. I asked to go. My family fell at Third Lamp, and I'd like to see it lit.
deep.brannGo.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §4.4 (Brann, the last of a family the highway wiped out at Third Lamp); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.guestsJoin.t: BRANN AND HEDDA WALK WITH YOU. They fight behind the four of you, their own way, and hold the road with you as far as Third Lamp.

deep.musterAlone.t: The Cleric's word is on the post: the ledger doubts you, so nobody walks with you. The road is yours alone.
deep.musterAlone.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §5.3 (the offer minus the escort); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.ledgerlamp.t: Ingrith sent this down for you: a ledger-lamp, dwarven, under warranty. It lights further than a torch, and it shows the seals: white for a whole one, red where one's been cut.
deep.ledgerlamp.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6.2 (Ingrith's gift: the ledgerlamp key item, the surveyor's instrument of the road)

deep.gateOpens.t: The gate goes up into the rock. Past it, the road: dressed stone down the middle, raw cavern either side, and dark all the way down.

t: First Lamp. Held. A lamp-tower burning, a cistern, a barrack-cut, eight of the garrison and their captain.
The day ends here.
deep.lamp1Arrive.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6.3 (First Lamp is held by Ulf Silversands and eight troopers, the forward post)

t: Ulf Silversands. The road is mine from here to Solskaft's mouth, for what that's worth this season.
Goblins came through a cut seal back up the road a month since. We threw them back. They didn't stay thrown.
deep.ulf1.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §4.4 (the road-captain, one of the four level-6s); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.lamp1Brann.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6 (the highway); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

t: Second Lamp. Dark two seasons. The tower cold, the cistern still running, dust on the cots.
Ingrith's abandoned place you can sleep. The day ends here, in the dark.
deep.lamp2Arrive.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6.3 (Second Lamp: dark, abandoned two seasons; the cistern still runs)

deep.lamp2Brann.t: Nobody's lit it since the last watch. Nobody says why.
deep.lamp2Brann.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §10-5 (the lamp declared unwarranted); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.lamp2Hedda.t: Sleep. I'll sit up. I always do, here.
deep.lamp2Hedda.src: drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.day3End.t: Three lamps lit. The road down to Deepholm is held.

deep.lampLit.t: The lamp burns. Somebody keeps it full.
deep.lampLit.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6 (the highway); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.lamp2Dark.t: The lamp is dark. Its warranty lapsed two seasons back, and the ledger holds a debt on it.

t: A warranted wall, breached from the far side. Its runes lie on the floor in pieces.
Beyond it, a cavern and a camp: hide tents, bones, a fire, and the smell of goblins.
deep.cutSeal.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6.3 (the cut seal: the goblins' camp behind it, a bugbear chief and a hobgoblin captain)

deep.cutSealIntro.t: The camp comes up off its blankets, blades first.
deep.cutSealIntro.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6 (the highway); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.cutSealDone.t: The camp is broken. In the cut edge of the seal, the rock shines: they drove the seal right through the seam.
deep.cutSealDone.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6.3 (a lump of the truesilver vein in the cut)

deep.veinBusy.t: A seam of something bright in the rock. Not with goblins at your back.
deep.veinBusy.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6 (the highway); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.vein.t: The seals were driven through the seam, and the seam is truesilver. A lump the size of a fist comes out of the cut with a knife and some patience.

deep.veinDone.t: The seam, and the gap where the lump came out.
deep.veinDone.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6 (the highway); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.roperCauseway.t: The causeway runs straight across the great cavern, the dark falling away either side. Ahead, a stalactite hangs low over it.
deep.roperCauseway.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6.3 (the roper at the fork: the causeway passes under a stalactite that is not a stalactite)

deep.roperSeen.t: The ledger-lamp catches it just so, and it isn't a stalactite. It has an eye.
deep.roperSeen.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6.3 (the light shows it: the base game's light law again)

deep.roperAgain.t: The thing over the causeway waits, pretending.
deep.roperAgain.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6 (the highway); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.roperAsk.t: The rim-path winds the long way round, south. Or you can pass under it.
deep.roperAsk.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6 (the highway); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.roperGrabs.t: The stalactite opens an eye, and its tendrils come down.
deep.roperGrabs.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6 (the highway); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.roperDone.t: The causeway is clear. What's left of it hangs there like a stalactite, which is all it ever wanted anyone to think.
deep.roperDone.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6 (the highway); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

t: The road bucks. Out of a breach in the south wall, rough-cut and new, something armored comes up through the stone like a fin through water.
deep.bulette.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6.3 (the thing that makes new connections: an unsealable breach, dug last month; a bulette for the umber hulk, which is not in the SRD 5.1)

deep.buletteDone.t: The breach it came up through is a month old. There was never a seal there to cut. There is no rune for a hole a beast dug.
deep.buletteDone.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6 (the highway); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.buletteHedda.t: That goes in the ledger as a hole. Ingrith will hate it.
deep.buletteHedda.src: drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.drain.t: The drainage cut under the station. Something black lies across the floor of it, glossy, still. The last watch's gear is on the floor beside it, what's left of it.
deep.drain.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §10-5 (the last watch died to the thing in the drainage cut, the black pudding)

deep.drainAsk.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6 (the highway); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.drainDone.t: The drainage cut is clear. Whatever the last watch owed, the thing that killed them is paid.
deep.drainDone.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6 (the highway); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.xorn.t: The wall ahead bulges, cracks, and something the size of a barrel pushes out of the rock, chewing.

deep.xornDone.t: It had been eating the seam. There are gems in the rubble it spat out.
deep.xornDone.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6 (the highway); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

t: Third Lamp. Dark. Shapes moving in the station, pale-haired and quiet, and the garrison's crates pulled into a barricade.
The underdark took the lamp.
deep.raidSee.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6.3 (Third Lamp taken: the underdark's raid holds the station)

deep.raidBrann.src: drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.raidHedda.t: Their captain, and one who weaves. Kill the weaver first or none of us walks out.
deep.raidHedda.src: drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.raidAsk.t: They haven't seen you. Not yet.
deep.raidAsk.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6 (the highway); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.raidIntro.t: Steel in the dark, and a voice already weaving.
deep.raidIntro.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6 (the highway); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.raidCrept.t: You are among them before the first one turns.
deep.raidCrept.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6 (the highway); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.raidSpotted.t: A pale head turns. A hand goes up. So much for that.
deep.raidSpotted.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6 (the highway); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.raidWon.t: The raid is broken. The station is quiet, and cold.
deep.raidWon.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6 (the highway); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.lamp3Lit.t: Brann lights the lamp with his own hands. Hedda watches him do it and says nothing, which is a kindness.
deep.lamp3Lit.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6.3 (the lamp relit = highwaySecured); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.lamp3LitAlone.t: You light the lamp yourselves. The flame takes. The road is held.
deep.lamp3LitAlone.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6 (the highway); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

t: Our orders end at the lamp. We hold it now, the two of us, till the season sends relief.
Past here is Deepholm's road. Walk softly on it.
deep.escortsStay.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §3 beat 6 (the escorts hold Third Lamp: "our orders end at the lamp"); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

t: Third Lamp's captain, where the raid left him in the barrack-cut. On his belt, beside the garrison knife, a second one: not issue. A ward-knot etched on the blade.
deep.captainSee.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §8 (the Greyseam knife: a sect blade on a garrison captain's body; the sect inside the garrison, shown not told)

deep.heddaKnife.t: Take it. Better it goes up the road with you than back to whoever gave it him.
deep.heddaKnife.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §4.4 (Hedda knows more than she says); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.captainRest.t: The garrison will carry him up to the Burial. The rows get longer.
deep.captainRest.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6 (the highway); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.deepRoad.t: Past Third Lamp the road is swept and dressed: Deepholm's now. (The rest of the road is the next part of this expansion.)
deep.deepRoad.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §14 (M3: the door and the road's people)

deep.smithLump.t: Truesilver. From the seam at the First Lamp seal. I haven't had my hands on any in thirty years. Bring me the thresher's flail and I'll put a head on it that'll outlast the both of you.
deep.smithLump.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §8 (the Winnower: re-hafted with a truesilver head by the Copperbottom smith); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.smithNoFlail.t: Not without the flail. Bring me the thresher, or the thresher's flail.
deep.smithNoFlail.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6 (the highway); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.smithAsk.t: A truesilver head on Barley's flail?
deep.smithAsk.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6 (the highway); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.smithWorks.t: The forge goes white. The anvil rings for an hour, and nobody in the works complains.
deep.smithWorks.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §6 (the highway); drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.smithWinnower.t: There. It'll thresh anything that stands still long enough. Call it the Winnower; that's what it does.
deep.smithWinnower.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-dwarven-expansion-spec.md §8; drafted by the code tab, PROPOSED (RULED 09-24: no [GRIZ] stubs; the seat drafts)

deep.noDiamond.t: Revivify wants a diamond worth three hundred gold, and there's none in the pack.

deep.revived.t: The diamond goes to dust. {name} breathes, and is up.
